_comment: The gate. PUBLIC-NEUTRAL: no prices, no plan names, no commercial mechanism. The four fields are exactly the AI's qualification fields (Video 1 S9), so nothing is asked twice once the conversation moves to WhatsApp. This page has no page-foot CTA and no sticky bar — the gate is the only action on it.
title: Start — send us four numbers
meta_description: Send four numbers about your furniture business and we will tell you honestly whether we can help, and which plan fits.

sections.headline: Send us four numbers.
sections.body: We will read them, tell you honestly whether we can help, and show you which plan fits. If we do not think it will work for you, we will say so.

sections.headline: Your four numbers
sections.body: Rough figures are fine. Nobody is checking, and nothing here is stored — the numbers go straight into your own WhatsApp message.

fields.label: Your monthly sales
fields.hint: Roughly what the business bills in a normal month.

fields.label: What you spend on ads now
fields.hint: Google, Facebook, Instagram, anything. Nothing is a fine answer.

fields.label: How many showrooms you have
fields.hint: Count only places a customer can walk into and sit on a sofa.

fields.label: How much you can produce in a month
fields.hint: What the factory can finish comfortably, not the record month.

sections.note: This opens WhatsApp with the message already written. You can read it and change it before you send.

items.title: We read your numbers
items.body: A real look at your business, not an automatic reply.

items.title: We ask two or three things
items.body: City, what you make, and how the enquiries reach you today.

items.title: We tell you where you stand
items.body: Which plan fits, what it would cost, and whether we think it will work. If it will not, we say so.
